_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

086C.name: PartThrottleMapScale
086C.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0878.name: WotMapScale
0878.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

0AEA.name: InjectorDeadTime
0AEA.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

0B12.name: ReturnlessFuelScale
0B12.desc: Global fuel multiplier of the returnless fuel system

0B6A.name: PartThrottleFuel
0B6A.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0EE0.name: WotFuel
0EE0.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

1148.name: BaroFuel
1148.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8)

241F.name: KnockThreshold
241F.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

24F6.name: SparkCoolantCorrA
24F6.desc: Spark correction against coolant temperature (one of two variants, chosen by the caller)

2500.name: SparkCoolantCorrB
2500.desc: Spark correction against coolant temperature (second variant)

25F0.name: IdleTargetRpm
25F0.desc: Target idle speed against coolant temperature

498F.name: ThrottleLimpFromVacuum
498F.desc: Substitute throttle position from manifold vacuum when the TPS has failed

7047.name: ThermistorCold
7047.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, cold range (-55 to 83 C), used after the pull-up is switched

7057.name: ThermistorHot
7057.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, hot range (13 to 127 C); coolant and intake air

0B06.name: PartThrottleFuelK
0B06.desc: K factor of the part-throttle base pulse width: (MAP - offset) * (256 + K) / 16

0B07.name: PartThrottleFuelMapOffset
0B07.desc: MAP offset of the part-throttle base pulse width

0B08.name: WotFuelK
0B08.desc: K factor of the WOT base pulse width

0B09.name: WotFuelMapOffset
0B09.desc: MAP offset of the WOT base pulse width

1950.name: RevLimit
1950.desc: Rev limit, used while $0C31,Z bit 5 is set (2GNT: manual transmission / park-neutral)

1952.name: RevLimitAlt
1952.desc: Rev limit, used while $0C31,Z bit 5 is clear

1955.name: SpeedLimit
1955.desc: Vehicle speed limit (compared with $0A9B,Z), active with calibration bit $0337.5

1957.name: SpeedLimitMinRpm
1957.desc: The speed limit is checked only above this rpm

3F88.name: FaultTable
3F88.desc: Fault attributes: id, trigger count, blink code, attributes, bit mask, byte offset, P-code (BCD), 2 spare bytes
